articles.summary: First Horizon Bank (NYSE: FHN) (or "First Horizon") is proud to announce the official grand opening of its Charlotte corporate office at 110 East Boulevard. Centrally located in the Queen City's popular South End neighborhood, the office is positioned for the team to build and strengthen relationships with clients across the Charlotte area, and it enables First Horizon to serve the community as the company continues to expand its footprint across the region. First Horizon is the anchor tenant at 110 East, a 24-story tower located in the city's East Boulevard corridor. Prominent First Horizon signage placement on the north and south sides of the building not only enhance the city's skyline, they signal the bank's commitment to the Charlotte community. "We plan to be in Charlotte for the long term, and this office is a visible sign of that. Our name on the Charlotte skyline says we intend to keep earning the trust of the people and businesses we serve here," said Bryan Jordan, Chairman
articles.title: First Horizon Bank Celebrates Grand Opening of Charlotte Corporate Office at 110 East

articles.summary: First Horizon Bank (NYSE: FHN or "First Horizon") has named Elizabeth Adler Treasury Management Sales Officer for the New Orleans market. "We are excited to have Elizabeth on the Treasury Management Sales team in New Orleans," said Tony Adams, Gulf States Regional President for First Horizon Bank. "Her commitment to building strong relationships and delivering exceptional service will enhance how we serve our clients and communities across the region." "Elizabeth has a strong understanding of the financial needs of businesses within this market and knows how to translate those needs into customized solutions," said Marcy Sasser, Senior Vice President of Treasury Management for Louisiana at First Horizon Bank. "Her collaborative approach and dedication to service excellence are an ideal fit for this role." Adler brings more than 30 years of banking and financial services experience to her new role. articles.summary: First Horizon Bank (NYSE: FHN) (or "First Horizon") today announced it is working alongside Catholic Charities of the Archdiocese of Galveston-Houston and AltCap to implement an innovative financing solution to build a new 60,000-square-foot facility that will significantly improve access to food and other services for low-income Houstonians. The new Family Opportunity Center in north Houston will leverage New Markets Tax Credits (NMTC) provided by First Horizon Bank and the Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI) AltCap. Slated to open its doors in 2028, the Family Opportunity Center will feature a market-style food pantry, thrift store, and access to the nonprofit's services, including mental health counseling, parenting classes, rental assistance and job readiness resources. articles.title: First Horizon Bank, Catholic Charities and AltCap Leverage New Markets Tax Credits to Build $25 Million Family Opportunity Center

articles.summary: First Horizon Bank (NYSE: FHN) (or "First Horizon") today announced Andrew Finkle as Palm Beach and Broward Market President, leading the local team and serving the bank's clients across the greater Palm Beach and Broward County, Florida region. Finkle previously served as First Horizon's Commercial Banking Team Lead for Broward and Palm Beach Counties. He has more than 25 years of experience in commercial and investment banking in addition to five years as the CFO of a middle-market wholesale distribution company. "Andrew is a trusted leader whose experience and commitment to our clients will serve Palm Beach and Broward counties well as Market President," said Marty Lanahan, South Regional President for First Horizon Bank. "His focus on service excellence, the community and our associates is central to how he leads every day." articles.title: First Horizon Bank Names Andrew Finkle Palm Beach and Broward County, Florida Market President
